title: Applause (Theatre Audience - Indoors) by christos71
author: christos71
sourceDescription: Long applause. Crowd of about 60 people in a small, indoors, theatre venue (full-house). "#0:21 someone is whistling entousiastically". "#1:05 people are starting leaving their seats and move toward the exit while speaking in low voices and whispers". Recorded with Tascam DR-05X portable mini recorder.
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain -2.00 dB (peak -0.50 dBFS); 30 ms fades
